mode.title: Mode
mode.description: unusual = contracts trading far above their open interest (the daily scan). chain = the option chain filtered by expiry, moneyness, and size. summary = one row per symbol with put/call ratios, totals, and 30-day implied vol.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: US tickers to pull option chains for, e.g. NVDA, TSLA, SPY. Index roots work with or without the caret: SPX, ^SPX, VIX, NDX, RUT. Maximum 25 per run.

optionType.title: Option type
optionType.description: Return calls only, puts only, or both.

minVolume.title: Min contract volume
minVolume.description: Skip contracts trading fewer than this many times today. In unusual mode this is the floor that keeps one-lot noise out of the scan.

minVolumeOiRatio.title: Min volume / open interest (unusual mode)
minVolumeOiRatio.description: How many times today's volume must exceed existing open interest to count as unusual. 5 means five times more contracts traded today than were open going in. Contracts with zero open interest always qualify on volume alone.

minOpenInterest.title: Min open interest
minOpenInterest.description: Skip contracts with open interest below this. 0 = no minimum.

expiries.title: Expiries (optional)
expiries.description: Filter to specific expiry dates in YYYY-MM-DD form, e.g. 2026-08-21. Empty = every listed expiry.

maxDaysToExpiry.title: Max days to expiry
maxDaysToExpiry.description: Drop contracts expiring further out than this many days. 0 = no limit. Useful for focusing on near-dated flow.

moneynessPercent.title: Strike window around spot (%)
moneynessPercent.description: Keep only strikes within this percentage of the underlying price, e.g. 10 = strikes within 10% either side. 0 = every strike. The main lever for cutting chain-mode row counts.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Order contracts before the row cap is applied.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned across all symbols. Controls total cost.
